Definition: a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn
BiblicalUsage: Shophar is the trumpet, the curved horn whose blast gathers, warns, and worships. It sounded on Sinai when the mountain smoked, it brought down the walls of Jericho when the priests blew and the people shouted, Gideon blew it on every side of the Midianite camp, the psalm calls us to praise God with its sound, and Joel bids us blow it in Zion because the day of the Lord is near.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the trumpet is God's alarm and God's invitation in one breath. It called Israel to war and to worship, and I hold that it still calls me to wake up and listen.
